notes.title: UPDATE 0.4 - The Chills of Cryvon Tundra
notes.content:
[p]Welcome to the newest patch of Defender Bros: The Chills of Cryvon Tundra!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774152/20abd8b3474dbd0c3619f7825fa0253447595297.png"][/img][/p][p]This Patch Features a new building, gun, enemies, boss, and skins!

The cryvon tundra can be unlocked by surviving the boss from the Zashir Depths and features a snowy planet environment that explores more verticality with a mountanous section.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Plasma Tower is an offensive building that beams plasma at your enemies with a very long range[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774152/f4c2fac26205575756b48af3685ea69012d9fba9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The Drone Gun Shoots projectile drones that shoot at enemies for a duration, aiding you in combat.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774152/e5a63d072d1bdf6a1457670cb826eccd0169d5eb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]There is a new set of skins unlocked by playing the Cryvon Tundra Map[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774152/b11104df92a2eb64f1f3c451327c09be8d75476b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Bug where dialog would only show once now fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Rocket launcher would not deal explosion damage to enemies nearby, it now deals splash damage to all nearby actors correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Playing the game at wider resolutions would cause the camera to be too close to the main character. The camera Field of view now adjusts automatically based on screen aspect ratio and should look a lot better on ultra wide resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Piercing bullets now work as intended even after grabbing other bullet effects[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience. There will be many more updates with more skins and bugfixes on the way. [/p][p]I am also finalizing plans for a major balancing update that will make every new map feel a lot harder and the progression a lot juicier. Stay tuned![/p]

tags.feature: The Plasma Tower is an offensive building that beams plasma at your enemies with a very long range
The Drone Gun Shoots projectile drones that shoot at enemies for a duration, aiding you in combat.
There is a new set of skins unlocked by playing the Cryvon Tundra Map

tags.bug: Bug where dialog would only show once now fixed.
Rocket launcher would not deal explosion damage to enemies nearby, it now deals splash damage to all nearby actors correctly

Playing the game at wider resolutions would cause the camera to be too close to the main character. The camera Field of view now adjusts automatically based on screen aspect ratio and should look a lot better on ultra wide resolutions.
Piercing bullets now work as intended even after grabbing other bullet effects

notes.title: UPDATE 0.25 - Christmas Event
notes.content:
[h2]Merry Christmas Defenders![/h2]

During this festive time of year, Defender Bros will feature a limited time event that adds new unlockable skins, map changes and more.

Start off the event by playing through the Garond Wastes, now with a [b]new winter touch[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774152/6047d27c8a59fb0cba8d99fe828e3561cf43a419.jpg[/img]

Then collect gifts around the map:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774152/6db376ec3fdd894119ce294125063384cc1ef697.gif[/img]

After collecting enough presents, you can unlock limited time skins only available during this event:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774152/eef04a49511c33554f75289aab30d2d986cf75a5.jpg[/img]


[h2]Full List[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Santa Claus Skin
[*] New Snowman Skin
[*] New Reindeer Companion Unit Skin
[*] Garond Wastes winter season
[*] Changes to the main menu environment to be more festive
[*] Turrets now have a santa hat :)
[/list]



Thank you for an amazing early access launch, and have a Merry Christmas!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2 - The Balancing Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there friends![/h2]

This patch brings much needed [b]balancing changes[/b] to the game that will make matches a lot more challenging the more consecutive nights you survive, as well as tweaks to scrap collection and enemy speed.

This patch also brings in requested features like [b]skin perks[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774152/62597f90ad4ed964c18d5c4be170ace34a361c5d.jpg[/img]

With skin perks you can equip yourself with [b]Uber weapons[/b], increasing your damage and firerate.
Equipping 3 of the same Uber weapon perk will also grant you with unlimited ammo without needing to reload

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774152/a6ee606d44663b96a3e1e6d77e77f11bedeeaa3c.gif[/img]

...And there's even a new Companion Unit Skin:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44774152/55fc566f7c5f2c36e4fb920835e24c1a6dc6b643.jpg[/img]

Here is the full List:

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Skin Perks
[*] Balancing Adjustment based on consecutive nights
[*] Scrap Collection reajusted
[*] Added option to change HUD scale
[*] New "Domesticated Spider" Companion Unit Skin
[/list]

[h2]Balancing Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Decelerating bullets perk slowdown was decreased from 50% to 20%
[*] Enemy Base Health and Damage was increased by 20 on Naraat-4 and by 40 on Zashir Depths
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sometimes ending a match in multiplayer would cause the game to freeze and not go back to main menu
[*] Broodmother would vanish instead of executing its death animation
[*] Potential fix to bug where game would be stuck at the character creation screen implemented
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.13
notes.content:
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] After a lot of work recompiling the game using Unreal Engine Source, we now have improved Crashlog Generation which will help immensely in fixing any crashes the game could have from now on
[*] Improved Monkey Unit AI
[*] Added a custom cursor and an option to change the cursor size on the gameplay options tab
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.11
notes.content:
Notice: Those with this icon :check_mark: are inspired by the players’ feedback. Thank you so much again.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] :check_mark: Stamina Recharge Cooldown was reduced by 75%
[*] :check_mark: Added Radius for objects to fade out between the player and the camera
[*] :check_mark: Big Tree with Hole in the Middle from Naraat-4 now fades out when between Player and Camera
[*] Increased Radius for object interaction, making it so you don't have to look at dropboxes to interact
[*] French Proofreading
[*] :check_mark: Added Option to Hold or Toggle Sprinting in the Options Menu under the Gameplay Tab
[*] :check_mark: There is now a "Your base is under attack" message that displays when your base takes damage
[*] :check_mark: Added a "Skip Day" functionality once all players have reached their building limits
[/list]
We are working on fixing bugs and adding more requested Quality of Life features, but we wanted to share what we already have done before the weekend. Please, keep the feedback coming, it is very precisous to us!!

notes.title: Heading Into Early access
notes.content:
Dear Playtesters and Curators,
Defender Bros is Heading into early access in 3-4 months. With that there are a couple of news to share:

[list]
[*] The Demo will be de-activated within the next 2 days. After this period, those who have already downloaded the Demo will no longer be able to play it.
[*] The Playtest will receive new updates and testers with keys will still be able to playtest until early access launch
[*] The Demo will come back in a more polished and final form at a later date (before early access launch)
[*] The game will be localized to multiple languages including, Brazillian portuguese, Chinese (Traditional and Simplified), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean and Russian.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and patience.

-Leozera, the game's developer
